title: Apple 公布 App Store Awards 入围名单，Arknights: Endfield、Dave the Diver 和 Ball x Pit 在列
content:
Apple names Arknights: Endfield, Dave the Diver and Ball x Pit among the App Store Awards finalists – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Apple has revealed the finalists for its
App Store Awards 2026
.
The iPhone Game of the Year finalists are Devolver’s Ball x Pit, Mintrocket’s Dave the Diver and Stray Fawn Studio’s chess roguelike Gambonanza.
In all, 21 games have been shortlisted across six categories, including Gryphline’s
Arknights: Endfield, which was named Google Play’s best game of 2026
in most markets. It’s up for iPad Game of the Year against Pawprint Interactive’s Aniimo and NetEase’s Where Winds Meet, which is also up against Arknights: Endfield for best mobile game at The Game Awards next month.
Perchang World, FuturLab’s PowerWash Simulator and Electric Square’s Pusheen’s Place will battle it out for Apple Arcade Game of the Year.
Six titles made the Cultural Impact Games shortlist: Kodansha’s And Roger, Hexecutable’s Consume Me, Antonio Uribe Prado’s PancitoMerge, Sago Mini Jinja’s Garden, Sound Games’ Spilled! and Skystone Games’ Tiny Bookshop. Apple says these games let players “grapple with the realities of eating disorders, discover the breadth of Mexico’s culinary culture, play as a family, clean up polluted waterways, and cozy up with an inclusive community.”
The tech giant says the winners will be selected and announced “in the coming weeks”.
